wsib_clearance.evidence: ATTACHMENTS lists 'WSIB Clearance Certificate' and INSURANCE COVERAGE section cites WSIB Account #3456789-01; however bid manifest qualifications.wsib_clearance_date is null and qualifications.wsib_in_good_standing is null — no clearance date or 'in good standing' wording extracted from the certificate.
wsib_clearance.notes: Certificate is attached so this is not a fail per skill §1, but validity window and good-standing text are not visible in the bid body. Owner must re-verify on clearances.wsib.ca prior to award (handled as standard award condition by roof-recommendation-memo). WSIB experience rating 1.12 is above the 1.00 industry baseline — flagged as a separate qualifications red flag (financial-distress / claims-history signal per fixture 04 §5).

cgl_insurance.evidence: INSURANCE COVERAGE section: 'Commercial General Liability: $5,000,000 per occurrence' equals RFP §5.1.2 / mandatory_requirements.cgl_minimum_cad of $5,000,000.
cgl_insurance.notes: Limit meets RFP minimum exactly. Named-insured / additional-insured / completed-operations questions tracked in their own gates.

additional_insured.evidence: Bid declares CGL limit but is silent on whether Tenebrus Capital is named as additional insured on the COI; qualifications.owner_named_as_additional_insured is null in the manifest.
additional_insured.notes: Standard commercial baseline per fixture 04 §2 — owner must verify the COI names Tenebrus Capital as additional insured before contract execution. Statutory tier per skill, but missing data is clarifiable, not a fail.

completed_ops.evidence: qualifications.cgl_completed_operations_years is null in the manifest; INSURANCE COVERAGE section names a CGL limit but does not state the completed-operations tail.
completed_ops.notes: Critical for the 20-year warranty period per fixture 04 §2. Owner should confirm the completed-ops tail extends through the warranty period before award.

performance_bond.evidence: Bid is silent on bonding capacity and consent of surety. RFP §9.2 requires a 50% performance bond on this OBC Part 3 project.
performance_bond.notes: Per skill §3: performance/L&M bonds are statutory on OBC Part 3 but missing consent of surety on the successful bidder is a fail at contract signing, not at submission. Mark needs_clarification at submission stage. qualifications.bonding_capacity_cad is null.

labour_material_bond.evidence: Bid is silent on L&M bond; RFP §9.2 requires a 50% L&M bond on this OBC Part 3 project.
labour_material_bond.notes: Same treatment as performance_bond — clarifiable at submission stage; consent of surety required before contract execution.

bid_bond.evidence: qualifications.bid_bond_attached is false. RFP mandatory_requirements does not set bid_bond_percent and submission_requirements (§6.2) does not list a bid bond.
bid_bond.notes: RFP-specified tier and the RFP did not invoke this gate (per gate_applicability.py). Strongest result is needs_clarification — cannot fail. Owner may waive or request a bid bond before award.

working_at_heights.evidence: SAFETY PROGRAM section states 'Fall protection equipment provided' but the bid does not confirm O. Reg. 297/13 Working-at-Heights training currency for on-site workers; qualifications.working_at_heights_training_confirmed is null.
working_at_heights.notes: Statutory under O. Reg. 297/13 (fixture 04 §3) but no explicit denial — only a missing confirmation. Owner should require WAH training records prior to mobilization.

site_visit.evidence: Cover Letter: 'We attended the site visit on March 25, 2026.' RFP §6.4 / §8.1 makes the site meeting mandatory.

minimum_years_in_business.evidence: Cover Letter: 'operating in the Greater Toronto Area since 2010' — 16 years as of 2026; qualifications.years_in_business = 16. RFP §5.1.3 requires minimum 10 years.

similar_project_references.evidence: Three references provided (REFERENCES section): Smallwood Industrial Park 48,000 sf (2024), Valley View Warehouse 52,000 sf (2023), Eastgate Commerce Centre 67,000 sf (2025). RFP §5.1.4 requires 3 references for similar projects 50,000+ sq ft completed within 5 years.
similar_project_references.notes: Count meets the minimum (3) and all are commercial/industrial low-slope roof replacements within the 5-year window. Smallwood at 48,000 sf falls just below the RFP's 50,000 sf size threshold — fails the RFP's stated comparability test on size. Valley View (52,000 sf) and Eastgate (67,000 sf) clearly comparable. Per skill Gate 8: count meets minimum but one reference fails the comparable test → needs_clarification, not fail. Owner may request a substitute or accept the marginal reference. Project values are not declared on any reference, limiting size-comparability verification.

addenda_acknowledgment.evidence: Bid does not acknowledge or list any RFP addenda; cover letter and bid body silent on addenda.
addenda_acknowledgment.notes: Prudent-evaluator tier per skill §5 — never a fail. RFP mandatory_requirements does not flag addenda_acknowledgment_required. Owner may request a signed acknowledgment prior to contract.

non_collusion_declaration.evidence: No non-collusion declaration is referenced in the cover letter, bid body, or ATTACHMENTS list.
non_collusion_declaration.notes: Prudent-evaluator tier per skill §6 — never a fail. RFP does not explicitly require a non-collusion declaration. Owner may request a signed declaration before award.

experience_references.notes: Three references provided. Two strictly comparable to RFP's 50,000+ sf threshold (Valley View 52K, Eastgate 67K); Smallwood (48K) is marginally under. Counted as 1-2 strictly comparable → 20 points. Most-recent comparable Eastgate 2025 (<1 yr) → 25 points. Verifiability is partial: every reference has named contact, scope sq ft, and completion year, but project value is missing on all three → 8 points (partial).

qualifications_certifications.notes: 16 years in business → 35 points (15+ band). No manufacturer certification declared (no Carlisle Authorized, GAF Master Elite, Firestone Red Shield, Sika Sarnafil, etc.) and no certified-installer status — critical given the 20-year manufacturer warranty claim. No Skilled Trades Ontario C of Q roofer count provided. CRCA / regional membership not declared.

schedule.notes: 90-day duration (May 15 – Aug 15 substantial; Aug 30 final) is realistic for 85,000 sf TPO tear-off and replacement → 30 points (realistic duration). No detailed phase sequencing or milestones beyond start / substantial / final, so does not earn the 40-point tier. Crew size not stated → 0 points. Both substantial and final completion dates are fixed against a stated start date → 20 points (RFP does not impose mandatory dates so 'meets both' applies). Occupied-building accommodation is generic ('Work can be phased to accommodate tenant operations if needed' / 'flexible on start date') with no named tenant-coordination plan or communication protocol for the pharmaceutical cold-storage tenants → 8 points.

red_flags.description: WSIB experience rating of 1.12 is above the 1.00 industry baseline, indicating worse-than-average claims history. Per fixture 04 §5, an elevated rating is a financial-distress / safety-performance signal that warrants owner due diligence before award on a 90-day occupied-building project.
red_flags.evidence: SAFETY PROGRAM section: 'WSIB Experience Rating: 1.12'; manifest qualifications.wsib_experience_rating = 1.12.

red_flags.description: No manufacturer certified-installer status declared. The bid claims a 20-year manufacturer warranty on the TPO membrane but does not name the manufacturer (Carlisle, GAF, Firestone, Versico, Sika, Johns Manville) and does not declare certified-installer credentials (e.g., Carlisle Authorized, GAF Master Select, Firestone Red Shield, Sika Sarnafil). Per fixture 02 §3, manufacturer warranties at this tier are typically only issued to certified installers; the warranty as offered may be unenforceable. Owner must verify before award.
red_flags.evidence: WARRANTY section ('20-year limited warranty on TPO membrane'); KEY SPECIFICATIONS / BID SUMMARY (no manufacturer named); no certification listed in ATTACHMENTS.

red_flags.description: Reference verifiability is incomplete: all three references include named contact, scope size, and completion year, but no contract value is provided on any. The RFP comparability test (50,000+ sq ft within 5 years) is met on size for two of three references; Smallwood Industrial Park (48,000 sf, 2024) is marginally below the RFP's 50,000 sf threshold.

No Skilled Trades Ontario Certificate of Qualification (313A roofer C of Q) crew count declared. For an 85,000 sf occupied OBC Part 3 commercial roof replacement, the absence of a stated C of Q crew count limits the owner's ability to assess installation quality and compliance with Skilled Trades Act requirements (fixture 04 §4).
red_flags.evidence: Bid is silent on C of Q roofer count; manifest qualifications.certificate_of_qualification_roofers_count is null.

red_flags.description: Crew size and mobilization-days-after-award are not declared. The bid commits to a 90-day duration but does not state crew composition or named foreman, limiting owner ability to assess production capacity and supervision continuity for an occupied-building project.
red_flags.evidence: PROJECT SCHEDULE section; manifest schedule.crew_size and schedule.mobilization_days_after_award both null.

red_flags.description: Working-at-Heights training under O. Reg. 297/13 is not affirmatively confirmed. Bid mentions 'Fall protection equipment provided' but does not state that on-site workers hold current WAH training certificates (3-year validity per fixture 04 §3).
red_flags.evidence: SAFETY PROGRAM section; manifest qualifications.working_at_heights_training_confirmed is null.

red_flags.description: No CRCA (Canadian Roofing Contractors Association) or regional roofing-association membership declared. Industry membership is a minor positive indicator of professional standards (fixture 04 §4) and is absent from the bid.
red_flags.evidence: Bid silent; manifest qualifications.crca_member is null.
